description: This file defines the class `VariableLengthRowBasedKeyValueBatch`, an implementation of a key-value batch with variable-length records, used in Spark SQL's catalyst module for handling row-based key-value data with variable sizes.

classes.name: VariableLengthRowBasedKeyValueBatch
classes.description: A final class extending RowBasedKeyValueBatch, managing variable-length key-value records with methods for appending rows, retrieving key/value rows, and iterating over records.

methods.name: appendRow
methods.description: Appends a key-value pair into the batch, copying data into the memory block, and returns an UnsafeRow pointing to the value.

methods.name: getKeyRow
methods.description: Retrieves the key row at a specified row ID, reusing the cached key row if available.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Retrieves the value row associated with a given key row ID, using metadata from the key row.

methods.name: rowIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator to traverse all key-value rows in the batch.
